base: Use case: style-transfer. One isolated full-body celestial character sprite for a children's library. Image 1 is original identity/palette reference. Image 2 (approved Jupiter) is STYLE reference: match its clean warm dark-brown outlines, softly shaded pastel finish, rounded forms and restrained glossy upper-left highlight. Exactly two glossy dark-brown eyes WITHOUT eyelashes, two subtle pink cheeks and one small centered smiling mouth directly on celestial body. No nose, arms, legs, hair, accessories, lettering or stars added.
specs: Mercury: round warm gray-brown rocky globe with a few softly shaded circular impact craters; no rings or cloud bands. Keep craters away from face.
Venus: round golden ochre and muted burnt-orange globe with broad soft swirling cloud bands. No rings or craters.
Mars: round warm terracotta and coral-red globe, subtle darker rust surface patches and sparse shallow craters. No rings or flame.
Neptune: round rich medium-blue and indigo globe, smooth broad curved blue cloud bands and one subtle darker blue atmospheric spot. No rings.
Uranus first variant: round light cyan turquoise globe with subtle soft curved teal cloud bands. No rings. Preserve its lighter turquoise identity distinct from deep-blue Neptune.

Uranus second variant: round cyan/teal globe with subtle horizontal curved cloud bands and one thin pale teal elliptical ring system diagonally tilted. Correct depth: rear ring hidden behind globe and front ring crossing lower third of globe, away from face. Entire ring visible and enough margin.
Moon: round pale cool-gray lunar globe with sparse medium-gray softly shaded circular craters surrounding the face, no rings, no atmosphere or cloud bands.

One golden-yellow five-point star with exactly five short rounded points, soft orange shading, a few restrained small pale golden surface highlights. Face directly in center of star. No arms or legs or other stars.

One rounded dark-gray rocky meteor head with a few soft craters and an attached orange and golden-yellow tapered flame trail extending diagonally up-left. Friendly smiling face centered entirely on rock head in lower-right, unobscured by flames or craters. One continuous flame trail behind rock, no other rocks.
